input: re-evaluate the swept band after a ring size or profile edit
expected: a RingRail -> RailProfile -> RailSweep chain rebuilds once when the ring diameter changes from 18 to 19 mm; the dependent sweep gets a new geometry revision and the plan is clean
notes: This build uses the OCCT registry, so the committed sweep is a B-Rep; the core reference backend test covers the analytic surface variant.
The chain is A -> B -> C: a ring edit re-stamps the profile against the new rail revision, then the sweep against the new profile revision.
A failed profile rebuild is reported as RecomputeOutcome::Failed and the sweep keeps its last committed geometry revision.
